intro: Jackson Heights is a significant immigrant community in Queens, with Chinese residents and small businesses spread across the area. Frequent enquiries here involve rental and landlord disputes, employment and wage questions, smaller debt claims, and property and inheritance arrangements within families. We provide consultation in Chinese.
